title: Geometric stalks of etale sum extension
statement:
Let $u:U\to X$ be an etale morphism of schemes [def-weil-etale-morphism], let $A$ be a commutative ring, and let $F$ be a sheaf of modules over the constant ring $A_U$ on the small etale site of $U$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-site, def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves]. Let $u_!F$ be the sheafified direct-sum presheaf [def-weil-pbc-etale-sum-extension]. For every geometric point $\bar x:\operatorname{Spec}\Omega\to X$ with $\Omega$ algebraically closed [def-weil-geometric-point], there is a natural $A$-linear isomorphism
$$
(u_!F)_{\bar x}\xrightarrow{\sim}\bigoplus_{\bar z:\operatorname{Spec}\Omega\to U,\ u\bar z=\bar x}F_{\bar z}.
$$
Stalks are geometric stalks [def-weil-pbc-geometric-stalks]. Under this isomorphism the germ represented by a section $s\in F(V\xrightarrow{a}U)$ in the summand indexed by $a$ of the presheaf on a pointed etale neighbourhood $(V,\bar v)$ of $\bar x$ is sent to the germ of $s$ in the summand indexed by $a\bar v$.
